title: Mi Gente/My People w/ DJ J Quinn

rows.title: Rocinha (feat. Robert Glasper, Godwin Louis and Patrick Pelissier)
Candela (feat. Busy Twist)
notes: “up next we got a latest track by get to kumbe ... this one is featuring busy twist called candela”
2025 Afro-Colombian/Caribbean collab single by Ghetto Kumbé and Busy Twist, later on the Cardones album.

rows.title: La Añoranza (feat. Coco Maria, Dengue Dengue Dengue & Ori Kaplan)
Pásalo
notes: “Do you want to tell us a bit about that track, Jackie, by Jelma? Yeah, Passalo... that's a hectic track... that Brazilian funk beat”
Melbourne Chilean-Australian reggaeton/Latin artist's 2026 single 'Pásalo' — ASR likely misheard 'Jalmar' as 'Jelma' and 'Pásalo' as 'Passalo'.

rows.title: SONiC HEALiNG (feat. MAMMOTH.)
notes: “so then talking about jupiter up next we've got... sonic healing... and who's that with mammoth yes mammoth on the track wrapping some really good bars on that”
2025 track by Naarm/Melbourne Latin-Australian artist JUPiTA featuring rapper MAMMOTH.

rows.title: Tra$hY Pr!nc3ss
notes: “And that one was by Cherry Chola, called Trashy Princess.”
2023 track by Mexico City-based artist Cherry Chola (stylised 'Tra$hY Pr!nc3ss').

rows.title: Mi Gatita Gangsta
notes: “and this one is called Mijeteta? That's it. Mijeteta Gangsta.”
Reggaeton track by Venezuelan-Australian artist LaMira, played on triple j Unearthed — 'Mijeteta' is likely an ASR mishearing of 'Mi Gatita'.
